explanation: On [-6,-4], the arc contributes a quarter-circle area minus a 2×2 rectangle: π−4. On [-4,-1], the triangle contributes 3. On [-1,1], the trapezoid contributes 4. On [1,5], the semicircle of radius 2 above y=1 contributes 2π+4. Thus the integral is (π−4)+3+4+(2π+4)=3π+7. Isolated endpoint values do not affect the integral.
